content: Hi! Please upload your Informatica PowerCenter XML export, or paste its contents here. I’ll analyze the mapping logic and convert it into a DBT model. If you know the target database (for example, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift), include that too.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<POWERMART CREATION_DATE="10/25/2026 10:00:00">

  <REPOSITORY NAME="DEV_REPOSITORY">
    <FOLDER NAME="ETL_FOLDER">

      <SOURCE NAME="SRC_CUSTOMER"
              DATABASETYPE="Oracle">
        <SOURCEFIELD NAME="CUSTOMER_ID"
                     DATATYPE="number"/>
        <SOURCEFIELD NAME="CUSTOMER_NAME"
                     DATATYPE="varchar"
                     LENGTH="100"/>
        <SOURCEFIELD NAME="CITY"
                     DATATYPE="varchar"
                     LENGTH="50"/>
      </SOURCE>

      <TARGET NAME="TGT_CUSTOMER"
              DATABASETYPE="Oracle">
        <TARGETFIELD NAME="CUSTOMER_ID"
                     DATATYPE="number"/>
        <TARGETFIELD NAME="CUSTOMER_NAME"
                     DATATYPE="varchar"
                     LENGTH="100"/>
        <TARGETFIELD NAME="CITY"
                     DATATYPE="varchar"
                     LENGTH="50"/>
      </TARGET>

      <MAPPING NAME="m_customer_direct_load">

        <INSTANCE NAME="SRC_CUSTOMER"
                  TRANSFORMATION_NAME="SRC_CUSTOMER"
                  TRANSFORMATION_TYPE="Source Definition"/>

        <INSTANCE NAME="TGT_CUSTOMER"
                  TRANSFORMATION_NAME="TGT_CUSTOMER"
                  TRANSFORMATION_TYPE="Target Definition"/>

        <CONNECTOR FROMINSTANCE="SRC_CUSTOMER"
                   FROMFIELD="CUSTOMER_ID"
                   TOINSTANCE="TGT_CUSTOMER"
                   TOFIELD="CUSTOMER_ID"/>

        <CONNECTOR FROMINSTANCE="SRC_CUSTOMER"
                   FROMFIELD="CUSTOMER_NAME"
                   TOINSTANCE="TGT_CUSTOMER"
                   TOFIELD="CUSTOMER_NAME"/>

        <CONNECTOR FROMINSTANCE="SRC_CUSTOMER"
                   FROMFIELD="CITY"
                   TOINSTANCE="TGT_CUSTOMER"
                   TOFIELD="CITY"/>

      </MAPPING>

    </FOLDER>
  </REPOSITORY>

</POWERMART>

## Here is your DBT model

The mapping is a direct pass-through: all three source columns are connected to target columns with the same names. No filters, expressions, or other transformations are defined.

**`models/customer.sql`**
```sql
select
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    CUSTOMER_NAME,
    CITY
from {{ source('raw', 'SRC_CUSTOMER') }}
```

Add a source definition so DBT can resolve the input table. Replace `YOUR_SOURCE_SCHEMA` with the Oracle schema containing `SRC_CUSTOMER`.

**`models/sources.yml`**
```yaml
version: 2

sources:
  - name: raw
    schema: YOUR_SOURCE_SCHEMA
    tables:
      - name: SRC_CUSTOMER
```

The XML doesn’t specify the source schema, so `YOUR_SOURCE_SCHEMA` is a placeholder.
